2609.26547.title: Topology-Stratified Materials Discovery with A Flow-Based Generative Model
2609.26547.paper_summary: Accurate generation of crystal structures is the foundation to the discovery of high-performance materials for extreme-environment applications, such as aerospace, additive manufacturing, and fusion energy systems. Although generative modeling has emerged as a promising approach for crystal design, its performance remains limited by the complex crystal structures and diverse chemical compositions. In this work, we develop UFO-MGen, a universal flow-based generative model that learns topological features of Wyckoff representations and leverages this information to accurately generate crystals across vast structural and chemical spaces. Compared with state-of-the-art generative models, UFO-MGen achieves the highest crystal generation success rate under a rigorous multi-stability evaluation framework, the highest SUN (stable, unique, novel) rate, and a remarkable extrapolation capability that has not been reported by previous models. Furthermore, a fine-tuning module is implemented to UFO-MGen for property-constrained crystal generation, enabling the inverse materials design toward target properties. The UFO-MGen opens a new avenue for accelerated materials discovery and providing a foundation for universal materials intelligence.
2609.26547.paper_summary_zh: 準確生成晶體結構是發現高性能材料的基礎，這些材料可用於極端環境應用，如航空航天、增材製造和核融合能源系統。儘管生成建模已成為晶體設計的一種有前景的方法，但其性能仍受到複雜晶體結構和多樣化化學成分的限制。在這項工作中，我們開發了 UFO-MGen，一種基於流的通用生成模型，該模型學習 Wyckoff 表示的拓撲特徵，並利用這些信息準確生成遍佈廣泛結構和化學空間的晶體。與最先進的生成模型相比，UFO-MGen 在嚴格的多穩定性評估框架下實現了最高的晶體生成成功率，最高的 SUN（穩定、獨特、新穎）率，以及前所未有的卓越外推能力。此外，UFO-MGen 還實施了一個微調模塊，用於屬性約束的晶體生成，使得針對目標性質的逆材料設計成為可能。UFO-MGen 為加速材料發現開辟了一條新途徑，並為通用材料智能提供了基礎。
